question: Does response curvature converge at matched small input radii after crossing phase with context, and do local two-tone interactions persist?

design.question: Does response curvature converge at matched small input radii after crossing phase with context, and do local two-tone interactions persist?
design.design: 32 independent synthetic backgrounds,8 per mixture type; every source crosses4 injection phases,2 frequency centers,3 amplitudes,2 local axes and3 measured RMS radii. Interaction crosses all4x4 phase pairs at each radius.
design.phase: Injection grid0/pi/2/pi/3pi/2 is common across backgrounds and independent of random background phases; source grouping includes every phase/path.
design.frequency_steps: Continuous root solve for RMS half-chord radius divided by fixed background SD; FP32 quantized input distance gate<=1e-7 absolute.
design.amplitude_steps: Peak amplitude increment chosen for same actual RMS radius; positive and negative endpoints preserve the same128-step background.
design.interaction: Four-point response on background x with two RMS-matched additions at24h/19.2h; report absolute mixed effect, each marginal denominator, sum denominator and input-distance product. Saved input-closure residual calibrates FP32 arithmetic contamination.
design.normalization: Matched native and actual background-locked normalizer/inverse on exactly the same saved inputs. Save full-token first/quarter/half hidden states and32-step forecasts.
design.gates: Exact repeats, background native/locked identity for both forecasts and hidden states, exact self-patch; finite arrays, source/checkpoint hashes, FP32 input radius/closure gates; no output-dependent source replacement.
design.primary: Per-source averages over dependent phase/amplitude cells: chord-relative curvature shrinkage at.01/.005/.002 RMS; input-normalized sensitivity convergence; native-versus-locked interaction and known-signal response. Preserve worst-source and phase curves.
design.inference: Exploratory fresh synthetic expansion, not sealed confirmation; resampling unit source seed, never phases or rows. No real-source generalization or model-training attribution.
design.analysis: Reuse FP64 response_surface_metrics arithmetic after capture; raw forecasts/states remain the authority. Persist knowledge.json after each execution including failures.
design.capture_status: NOT STARTED. Native slots reserved for natural-data and comparability. This driver is prepare-only.
design.prospective_execution: After explicit release: serial bounded shards of4 background sources;1CPU thread,3GiB and600 seconds per model/shard. Freeze capture-driver source in an addendum before its first launch; do not mutate this protocol.

controls: Exact repeats, background native/locked identity for both forecasts and hidden states, exact self-patch; finite arrays, source/checkpoint hashes, FP32 input radius/closure gates; no output-dependent source replacement.
limitations: Exploratory fresh synthetic expansion, not sealed confirmation; resampling unit source seed, never phases or rows. No real-source generalization or model-training attribution.
evidence_class: Frozen prospective design only; no model results
next_decision: HOLD native capture. Current native slots belong to dictionary/comparability; no native process has been started by this followup.
